result: If I had the power to change the world in one way, I would choose to eliminate global poverty. Poverty affects billions of people around the world, limiting access to basic necessities like food, clean water, healthcare, and education. Eradicating poverty could lead to significant improvements in health, education, and overall quality of life for those affected, fostering a more equitable and just society. This change would have ripple effects across the globe, promoting stability, reducing conflicts over resources, and encouraging innovation and growth.
